title: sorbus arbutifolia
intro: Sorbus arbutifolia, commonly known as Korean Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia, known for its distinctive red berries and aromatic properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus arbutifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
